canonical_name: Open Electric Jam ft. the King Street House Band
summary: A weekly (Sunday) house-band-led jam night at 185 King Street, a live music venue and brewery in Brevard, NC (not Harrah's Cherokee Center Asheville, which is a data error in the organizer field). The venue's own house band kicks off the set at 5pm and then invites any musician who shows up to plug in and sit in, described with 'drop-in musicians welcome' and 'all skill levels'.

evidence.note: Listings describe the venue's House Band kicking off at 5pm with others 'welcome to join'; tags include 'House Band Led', 'Drop In Musicians Welcome', 'Casual Barroom Vibe' and 'all skill levels', with no membership or regulars language.
Location across all three listings is 185 King Street/185 King St, Brevard, NC, not the organizer field's 'Harrah's Cherokee Center Asheville' - that field is wrong.

185 King Street is a commercial music venue and brewery (home of Noblebräu Brewing) with a full recurring events calendar; this jam is one of several weekly programmed nights (a separate Monday 'Old Time Mountain Music Jam' also runs there).

The venue's own event page frames it as the house band's regular Sunday show that sitting-in musicians can join; no sign-up sheet, roster, or community/member language, and no separate Facebook group or page for the jam itself beyond the venue's own social accounts.

No evidence of a distinct jam 'community' identity (no dedicated Facebook group, Meetup, or member list) beyond the venue's house band and its recurring open-invitation sit-in slot - reads as a venue's band residency plus open jam, the pattern the instructions call NOT a group.
